description: USDA WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates) figures for one commodity and region from the official monthly report-data CSV: attribute (e.g. Production, Ending Stocks), market year, value and unit. Defaults to the latest month available; the CSV is about 1 MB, so each call downloads one month. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

commodity.description: Commodity name as in the CSV, e.g. Corn, Wheat, Soybean, Cotton (default Corn)

month.description: Report month YYYY-MM (default: this month, falling back to last month)

region.description: Region name as in the CSV, e.g. United States, World (default United States)

name: energy_usda_wasde_crop_reports
title: Energy Usda Wasde Crop Reports
